server.name: io.github.andresdefi/zerodust
server.description: Sweep native gas tokens to exactly zero across 25+ EVM chains via AI agents.

environmentVariables.description: Custom API URL (defaults to https://api.zerodust.xyz)
environmentVariables.name: ZERODUST_API_URL

environmentVariables.description: API key for higher rate limits
environmentVariables.name: ZERODUST_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to enable the sweep tools. Sweeping moves real funds, so it is off by default and also requires ZERODUST_PRIVATE_KEY.
environmentVariables.name: ZERODUST_ALLOW_EXECUTE

environmentVariables.description: Private key for the agent's own wallet, used locally to sign the EIP-7702 authorization and EIP-712 sweep intent. Never transmitted; only the resulting signatures are sent.
environmentVariables.name: ZERODUST_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowlist of sweep destinations. When unset, funds can only be swept to the agent's own address.
environmentVariables.name: ZERODUST_ALLOWED_DESTINATIONS

server.name: io.github.andresdefi/zerodust
server.description: Recover stranded native gas: empty a chain's balance to exactly zero on 25 EVM chains.

environmentVariables.description: Custom API URL (defaults to https://api.zerodust.xyz)
environmentVariables.name: ZERODUST_API_URL

environmentVariables.description: API key for higher rate limits. An agent can issue itself one with the zerodust_register_api_key tool, with no human signup step.
environmentVariables.name: ZERODUST_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to enable the sweep tools. Sweeping moves real funds, so it is off by default and also requires one of the four signing-key variables below.
environmentVariables.name: ZERODUST_ALLOW_EXECUTE

environmentVariables.description: Path or specifier of a module whose default export returns a viem LocalAccount. This is how Turnkey, Privy, AWS KMS or any other custody service is used, without a raw key ever reaching this server. Preferred over ZERODUST_PRIVATE_KEY.
environmentVariables.name: ZERODUST_SIGNER_MODULE

environmentVariables.description: Path to an encrypted V3 keystore (as produced by `cast wallet import` or geth). Requires ZERODUST_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD_FILE or ZERODUST_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD.
environmentVariables.name: ZERODUST_KEYSTORE_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Path to a file containing the keystore password, so the password never enters the MCP config.
environmentVariables.name: ZERODUST_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Keystore password inline. Prefer ZERODUST_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD_FILE.
environmentVariables.name: ZERODUST_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Path to a file containing a hex private key, so the key stays out of the MCP config.
environmentVariables.name: ZERODUST_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Private key for the agent's own wallet, inline. Used locally to sign the EIP-7702 authorization and EIP-712 sweep intent; never transmitted, only the resulting signatures are sent. The signer-module, keystore and key-file options above keep it out of your config entirely.
environmentVariables.name: ZERODUST_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowlist of sweep destinations. When unset, funds can only be swept to the agent's own address.
environmentVariables.name: ZERODUST_ALLOWED_DESTINATIONS
